neighbours.label: the third digit '9' of years 189x / 199x (e.g. 18[9]9, 19[9]9)
fire: The bridge over the river was finished in 1899 after six years of work.
Her family emigrated to Canada in 1998, when she was still a toddler.
The treaty was signed in 1899 and remained in force for half a century.
The old ferry kept running until 1999, when the tunnel finally opened.
The first edition was printed in 1896 by a small press in Leeds.
Floods destroyed most of the harvest in 1997 across the northern plains.
The hospital opened its maternity ward in 1893 with only twelve beds.
The method was still in use as late as 1999 in several rural clinics.
quiet: The bridge over the river was finished in 1874 after six years of work.
Her family emigrated to Canada in 2003, when she was still a toddler.
The treaty was signed in 1815 and remained in force for half a century.
The old ferry kept running until 2008, when the tunnel finally opened.
The first edition was printed in 1852 by a small press in Leeds.
Floods destroyed most of the harvest in 1936 across the northern plains.
The hospital opened its maternity ward in 1870 with only twelve beds.
The method was still in use as late as 2011 in several rural clinics.

notes: Probe: the 1899/1999 sentence scored 0.60 (peak '9'), the strongest mode. The geographic-qualifier mode was weaker: 'Western Ghats' 0.44, 'continental Antarctica' 0.27, 'inner Hebrides' 0.17. Same sentences without the qualifier 0.09-0.10. This test covers only the year mode; quiet years have no 9 in the third position. Whether 1896/1893/1997/1998 fire like 1899 is untested.
